sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 3, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Second Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
3 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1985]
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.- (1) This Order maybe called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Second Amendment) Order, 1985. -
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 7, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 7,-
(a) in the marginal heading, the
words "candidates and" shall be omitted ;
(b) in clause (1),-
(i) the words
and comma "who is a candidate for election to a House or a Provincial
Assembly, and, every person" shall be omitted ; and
(ii) for the
words and commas "First. Schedule or. as the case may be, the Second
Schedule" the word "Schedule" shall be substituted ; ,
(c) clause (2) shall be omitted ;
and
(d) in clause (3), the word
"Second" shall be omitted.
3. Amendment of Article 12, P. (P. P.) 0. No. 5 of 1977.-In
the said Order, for Article 12, the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"12. Bar against double membership.-(1)
No person shall, at the same time, be a candidate for election to a seat in
both Houses, or the Assemblies of the Provinces or to more than one seat in the
same House or Provincial Assembly.
(2) If a person
is elected to a seat in a House and a seat in a Provincial Assembly, he shall,
within a period of fifteen days after the declaration of the result for the
second such seat, resign one of his seats and, if he does not so resign, the
seat to which he has been elected earlier or if he has been elected to both the
seats on the same day, the seat for election to which his nomination was filed
earlier shall become vacant at the expira tion of the said period.
(3) If any person contravenes the provisions
of clause (1), he shall be disqualified for a period of five years from
being, or being elected as, a member of a House or a Provincial Assembly."
4. Substitution of the Schedules, P. (P. P.) 0. No. 5 of 1977.-In
the said Order, for the First and Second Schedules the following shall be
substituted, namely :-
"THE SCHEDULE
(Article 7)
I---------, having been elected
as a member of the National Assembly/Senate Provincial Assembly of------ in accordance with the Proclamation of the
fifth day of July, 1977, read with the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 swear that 1 will bear true faith
and allegiance to Pakistan sovereignty and integrity of Pakistan :-
That as a member
of the National Assembly/Senate/Provincial Assem bly, I will be faithful to the
declaration of the Founder of Pakistan, Quaid -i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah, that
Pakistan would be a democratic state based on Islamic principles of social
justice ;
And that I will strive to
preserve the Islamic Ideology which is the basis for the creation of
Pakistan."
